_doc: Hand-written per-sentence Higgs TTS 3 control tags (PROMPTING.md of bosonai/higgs-tts-3-4b: sentence-level emotion/style/prosody tags at the start of a sentence, inline pause and sfx where they fire; an sfx tag must be followed by its onomatopoeia). Shape: passage -> segment -> sentence, as segments.json; null = the sentence as written. Mapped from passages/directions.json (the Ming study's 7 emotions) to Higgs' 21: fearful -> fear, surprised -> surprise, angry -> anger, happy -> amusement (Tom is joking), sad -> sadness / helplessness / longing, neutral reflective narration -> contemplation; Ming's [Laughter] -> sfx:laughter, [Sigh] -> sfx:sigh, [Uhm] and [Breathing] -> prosody:pause (Higgs has no breathing or filler tag).
1-suspense: <|emotion:surprise|>Then the gulls rose, all at once, without a sound.
<|emotion:fear|>Somewhere beneath him, on the iron stairs, <|prosody:pause|> a step creaked.
<|emotion:confusion|>Nobody had crossed the causeway; he would have seen them.
<|emotion:fear|><|prosody:speed_slow|>The steps were slow and heavy, <|prosody:pause|> and they were getting closer.
<|emotion:fear|><|prosody:speed_slow|>The door handle began, <|prosody:pause|> very slowly, <|prosody:pause|> to turn.
2-dialogue: <|emotion:anger|>"Are you going to tell me where you were last night?"
<|emotion:anger|><|prosody:expressive_high|>"Don't you dare make a joke of this!
<|emotion:anger|>I waited up until two in the morning, Tom.
<|emotion:helplessness|>I'm not sure I can <|prosody:pause|> explain it, not properly."
<|emotion:sadness|><|prosody:speed_slow|>"Then try," she said, more quietly now.
<|emotion:fear|>"I think someone has been following me.
<|emotion:confusion|><|prosody:pause|>Or perhaps I've imagined the whole thing.
3-reflective: <|emotion:contemplation|>There is a particular kind of quiet that comes only in the last hour before dawn.
<|emotion:contentment|>The house still ticks, and the wind still moves in the chimney.
<|emotion:contemplation|>Yet the mind is quiet, because the day's arguments have not yet begun.
<|emotion:contemplation|><|sfx:sigh|>Haah, now, more often, I simply sit.
<|emotion:contemplation|>I watch the window turn from black to grey, <|prosody:pause|> and from grey to the faintest blue.
<|emotion:contemplation|>What I have learned, if I have learned anything at all, is this: <|prosody:pause|> the things that matter most rarely announce themselves.
<|emotion:longing|><|prosody:speed_slow|>And they ask only that we be still enough to notice.
